department: Department of Earth, Ocean & Atmospheric Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by 15 January 2027 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline15 January 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to this field.

supervisor.value: No prior commitment is needed, but find a suitable supervisor and contact them before applying.
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged. | to identify who would be a suitable supervisor and to contact this person before applying to the department.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: PhD students normally hold a master's in science or applied science.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. degree program normally possess a master's degree in an area of science or applied science, with clear evidence of research ability or potential.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with section minimums.
